author: wittjosiah
principle: Use the correctly typed API (e.g. global lib types) instead of casting with `as any` to work around missing type information.
fix_shape: add/import the proper type definitions instead of casting to any

author: wittjosiah
principle: Bump a dependency version in the shared catalog rather than in an individual package.json, so there is one source of truth for versions.
fix_shape: move the version bump into the workspace catalog entry instead of editing the package.json directly

author: wittjosiah
principle: Before adding a new check/script, verify an existing build task doesn't already enforce the same constraint.
fix_shape: remove the new script and rely on the existing task's check, or clarify why it is insufficient

author: wittjosiah
principle: Make a React context value's fields required and enforce their presence with an invariant in the consuming hook, rather than making them optional, unless the optionality is a deliberate progressive-enhancement case.
fix_shape: make the context fields required and add an invariant check in the hook instead of optional chaining everywhere

author: wittjosiah
principle: Add a comment explaining why a non-obvious configuration value or option was chosen, so future readers don't need to rediscover the reasoning.
fix_shape: add a short comment documenting the rationale for the specific option value

author: wittjosiah
principle: Follow a consistent prop ordering (e.g. ref last/first) across components rather than varying it per file.
fix_shape: reorder the JSX props/spread to match the codebase's established convention

author: dmaretskyi
principle: Import from the project's own wrapper package around a third-party library rather than importing the third-party library directly, when a wrapper already exists.
fix_shape: change the import to the internal wrapper package instead of the raw upstream package

author: dmaretskyi
principle: Import from the project's own wrapper package around a third-party library rather than importing the third-party library directly, consistently across every file that uses it.
fix_shape: apply the same import swap to every remaining usage in the codebase, not just the first one

author: dmaretskyi
principle: Place logic that other layers/packages need to consume in a shared lower-level package rather than embedding it in a specific host package.
fix_shape: move the function to the appropriate shared package and import it from there

author: dmaretskyi
principle: An incremental/paginated update method should return a completion flag so callers know whether to continue processing rather than guessing from other fields.
fix_shape: add a boolean `done` field to the return type and use it to decide whether to re-invoke

author: dmaretskyi
principle: When a method returns a completion flag for incremental work, the caller must check it and re-invoke until it reports done.
fix_shape: destructure the completion flag and loop/rerun while it is false

author: dmaretskyi
principle: Import an existing shared type from its canonical package instead of redefining an equivalent local type.
fix_shape: import the type from its source package instead of declaring a parallel local interface

author: dmaretskyi
principle: Scope every query in a multi-space (multi-tenant) system by space id to avoid leaking data across spaces.
fix_shape: add a spaceId parameter/filter to the query type and its SQL

author: dmaretskyi
principle: Scope every query in a multi-space (multi-tenant) system by space id, implemented via a join/filter against the owning table.
fix_shape: join against the metadata/owner table to filter results by space id

author: dmaretskyi
principle: When reimplementing a mechanism that existed before, carry forward its documentation (e.g. serialization format notes) rather than leaving the new version undocumented.
fix_shape: add the doc comment describing the format, copying it from the prior implementation

author: dmaretskyi
principle: Use the platform's built-in mechanism (e.g. Worker.terminate()) instead of a custom ad hoc message protocol for the same purpose.
fix_shape: call the standard API method instead of implementing a custom message type for it

author: dmaretskyi
principle: Add a comment stating the purpose of cleanup/shutdown code so its intent is clear to future readers.
fix_shape: add a short comment above the shutdown logic explaining why it exists

author: dmaretskyi
principle: Do not register two independent handlers for the same event target that could silently overwrite or conflict with each other; consolidate into one dispatcher.
fix_shape: combine the handlers into a single dispatcher instead of assigning the event callback twice

author: mykola-vrmchk
principle: Add JSDoc for schema/struct fields whose meaning isn't obvious from the field name alone.
fix_shape: add a JSDoc comment describing the field's purpose

author: dmaretskyi
principle: Guard a check-then-create memoization pattern with a semaphore/lock to avoid a race between concurrent callers, rather than a bare map lookup followed by a set.
fix_shape: wrap the check-and-insert step in a semaphore so only one caller creates the memo entry

author: dmaretskyi
principle: Use the domain-specific wrapper type (e.g. EncodedReference) rather than its generic underlying representation (e.g. a bare DXN) when representing a reference field.
fix_shape: change the field/parameter type from the generic representation back to the specific domain type

author: dmaretskyi
principle: Use the domain-specific wrapper type (e.g. EncodedReference) rather than its generic underlying representation (e.g. a bare DXN) when representing a reference field, except where the generic type is explicitly acceptable.
fix_shape: change the field/parameter type from the generic representation back to the specific domain type

author: dmaretskyi
principle: Use the domain-specific wrapper type (e.g. EncodedReference) rather than its generic underlying representation (e.g. a bare DXN) when representing a reference field.
fix_shape: change the field/parameter type from the generic representation back to the specific domain type

author: dmaretskyi
principle: Use the domain-specific wrapper type (e.g. EncodedReference) rather than its generic underlying representation (e.g. a bare DXN) when representing a reference field.
fix_shape: change the field/parameter type from the generic representation back to the specific domain type

author: dmaretskyi
principle: Wrap a primitive value (e.g. a DXN) in the domain's dedicated encapsulating type (e.g. EncodedReference) rather than using the primitive directly throughout the codebase.
fix_shape: change the type to the encapsulating domain class instead of the raw primitive it wraps

author: dmaretskyi
principle: Use the platform's existing configuration mechanism (e.g. nested export conditions) instead of writing custom resolution logic to achieve the same effect.
fix_shape: model the behavior via built-in conditions/config instead of a bespoke resolver function

author: dmaretskyi
principle: After a refactor removes the meaningful branches of a function, delete the now-dead/no-op wrapper rather than leaving it in place.
fix_shape: delete the function/wrapper that no longer performs any work as a result of the refactor

author: wittjosiah
principle: Keep a `@default` JSDoc annotation in sync with the actual default value in the code.
fix_shape: correct the @default value in the JSDoc (or the code) so they match

author: wittjosiah
principle: When refactoring a branching block, preserve handling for the negative/else case rather than silently dropping it.
fix_shape: restore the else-branch behavior or explicitly justify why it is no longer needed

author: wittjosiah
principle: Add comments explaining the various cases in a non-trivial dispatch/branching function so a reader doesn't have to reverse-engineer them.
fix_shape: add comments describing each case in the branching logic
